source: English translation extracted and cleaned from the user-supplied bilingual Hizbul-Azam PDF

items.text: 1. O Allah, O The Greatest, O The One who hears and sees all things, O The One who has no partner and no minister, O The Creator of the sun and the brilliant moon, O The One who is the Refuge for a fearful destitute longing for protection. O The Nourisher of an infant, O

The Healer of a fractured bone, I beg You like the begging of a poor beggar or a helpless blind man. I beg You through Your Throne which is wrapped in dignity, through the keys of mercy which is contained in Your Book and through the eight names which are imprinted on the first visible part of the rising sun You make the Holy Qur- aan a source of comfort to my heart and a cure for my grief. O our Rabb, bless us in this world with
) (here mention whatever you desire)
2. O The Comforter and Companion of every lonely person,

O The One who is near and never far, O The One who is present and never absent, O You who subjugates all but is never overpowered in any way, O The Everlasting and Sustainer, The Majestic and Benevolent

3. O The One who is the light of the heavens and the earth. O The One who is the beauty of the heavens and the earth. O The Mighty Sovereign of the heavens and earth. O The sole supporter of the heavens and earth. O The Originator of the heavens and earth. O The Sustainer of the heavens and earth. O : 179
The Majestic and Kind. O The One who answers the pleas of people and is the last resort for those who seek protection,

O You Who relieves the pain of people in discomfort, soothes the sorrow of the grieving and responds favourably to the duas of those in difficulty. O The One who removes all uneasiness. O The Rabb of the worlds. O The One who is Most Merciful and Compassionate, we humbly place all our needs before You
4. O Allah, I seek Your protection from death in a state of worry
And I seek your protection from death in a state of grief, and I seek Your protection from hunger as it is an evil companion and from dishonesty as it is the worst of character

5. O Allah, make my inner self better than my outer self and make my outer self pious and righteous. O Allah, I beg of You to bless me with all the good that You have blessed others by way of wealth, spouse and children who are not misguided and do not misguide others
6. O Allah, include us among Your selected servants whose hands and feet are shining and they belong to the group of Your accepted ones
7. O Allah, I seek Your protection from joining any partners with You knowingly and I beg Your forgiveness for all that I have done unknowingly
8. O Allah, by Your Magnificent Countenance and Your Great Name
I seek Your protection from kufr (disbelief) and poverty
9. O Allah, save me from the evil of my carnal desires and give me the courage to discharge my responsibilities in the best possible manner
10. O Allah, do not leave me to myself for the blinking of an eye and do not snatch away from me whatever good You have already bestowed upon me, as none can take away what
You have bestowed nor can anyone hold back what You choose to bestow. And the wealth of the wealthy cannot safeguard them
11. O Allah, I beg You for the prosperity of my family members and well-wishers and seek Your protection from the curse of a relative whom I have cut off ties with
12. O Allah, I beg of You for a heart which is at peace with You, which believes in meeting You, is pleased with Your decree and is contented with Your gifts
13. O Allah, I seek Your protection from the evil of those (animals) which crawl on their bellies, those animals which walk on two legs and those which walk on four legs

14. O Allah, I seek Your protection from a wife who makes me old before my time, from children who become a nuisance to me, from wealth which becomes a punishment for me and from a disloyal friend who conceals my good and discloses my faults far and wide

15. O Allah, You know well what I conceal and what I reveal so please accept my repentance. (O Allah) You know my needs so please bless me with what I am begging for and You know what is in my heart so please forgive my sins. O Allah,
I beg of You to bless me with such Imaan that penetrates my heart and the proper (yaqeen) conviction which will enable me to realise that whatever befalls me was already predestined by You for me
Allow me to be pleased with whatever You have apportioned for me. Verily You have power over everything
16. O Allah, You alone are worthy of such praise which remains eternal with Your eternity
You alone are worthy of praise which is continuous with Your continuity. You alone are worthy of praise which will not end except by Your will
You alone are worthy of eternal praise, in a manner in which the one praising You desires nothing but
Your pleasure. You alone are worthy of praise at every blink of the eye, and at every breath
17. O Allah, turn my heart towards Your Deen and guard us from behind through Your Mercy
18. O Allah, keep me firm lest I should slip (from the right path) and continue to guide me lest I should be misguided
O Allah, as You have intervened between me and my heart, intervene between me and shaytaan and his evil doings

19. O Allah, grant us (rizq) sustenance by Your Grace, do not deprive us of Your sustenance, add (barkat) blessings to the sustenance You grant us, favour us with the wealth of contentment and grant us a passion for that whicht is with You (i.e. spiritual blessings)
20. O Allah, You are the Creator, full of greatness. You hear and know everything. You are Forgiving and Merciful and You are indeed the Rabb of the
Great Throne. O Allah, You are extremely Compassionate, Generous and Kind

Please forgive me and have mercy on me. Grant me ease and sustenance, cover my faults, restore my losses, elevate me, guide me, do not let me go astray and admit me to Jannah through Your Mercy, O Most
Merciful of those who show mercy
21. O Allah, make me beloved to You, place in my heart submission towards You and grant me honour in the eyes of the people and save me from evil manners
22. O Allah, You have asked us to do things which we are not able to do except with Your help (i.e. righteous deeds and sincere ibaadat) so grant us the ability to do such deeds which will please You

23. O Allah, I beg of You (to bless me with) Imaan which remains forever, and I ask You for a submissive heart and true conviction. I ask You for firmness in Deen and I beg You for safety from all mishaps
I beg You for continuous aafiyat (ease, safety), I beg You to make me grateful for the aafiyat (ease) You have granted to me and make me independent of people

24. O Allah, I seek Your protection from arrogance due to wealth and disgrace due to poverty. O The One who fulfils His promises, Who warned of punishment but instead forgave us, please forgive the one who has committed injustice and acted wrongly. O The One to Whom my obedience brings pleasure and my sins cause Him no harm, grant me what is pleasing to You and forgive me, from that which causes You no harm

25. O Allah, I seek Your protection from having doubts in the truth after being convinced. I seek Your protection from the accursed devil and I seek Your protection from the evil of the Day of Judgement
26. O Allah, I beg Your forgiveness for sins which I have committed after having repented for them
I beg Your forgiveness for all the promises which I made to You but failed to fulfil them. I beg Your forgiveness for having used Your favours to commit sins against You

I beg Your forgiveness for all such actions which I intended to do purely for Your sake but thereafter mixed them with something which was not solely for Your pleasure. O Allah, do not disgrace me even though You know everything about me and do not punish me even though You have full power over me

27. O Allah, make me from amongst those who placed their trust in You and then found You to be sufficient. (Make me from those) who sought guidance from You and were then guided and (make me from those) who asked You for help and then You helped them

28. O Allah, change the stray thoughts of my heart into fear for You and remembrance of You, and O Allah divert my courage and desires to do such deeds which will please You. O Allah, in whichever way You may test me, whether with mildness or difficulty, make it such that I remain firm on the path of truth and upon the commandments of Islam

29. O Allah, I beg of You to bless me with complete favours in all matters and I beg You to allow me to be grateful over them until You are pleased and after being pleased choose for me all those things which are to be chosen and O Allah,
Most Gracious I ask You for ease in all my tasks not that You make it difficult for me, O The Most Kind

30. O Allah, The One Who brings out the morning and has made the night , a time of rest, and the sun and the moon a means of calculating (time), pay out my debts, free me from poverty and give me the strength to make Jihaad in Your path
31. O Allah, all praises are due to You in Your tests and doings with

Your creation. All praises are due to You with Your tests and doings with our household. All praises are due to You in Your tests and doings specifically with our lives. All Praise is due to You for having guided us

Praise is due to You for having honoured us. Praise is due to You for covering our faults. Praise is due to You on account of the Holy Qur-aan and praise is due to You for the family and wealth (You bestowed on us). Praise is due to You for having granted us safety and praise be to You until You are pleased. Praises be upon You when You become pleased, O The
One Who ought to be feared and The One Who is worthy of forgiving (sins)

32. O Allah, bless me with the taufeeq (ability) to do all such words, deeds, actions, intentions and acts of guidance that will lead to earning Your pleasure and happiness. Verily You have power over everything
33. O Allah, The Rabb of the seven heavens and The Rabb of the Great
Throne (Arsh). O Allah, be sufficient for me in every important matter as
You wish and from wherever You wish
34. Allah is enough for me for my Deen. Allah is enough for me whenever I am worried

Allah is enough for when I am victimised by anybody, Allah is enough for me when someone is jealous of me or when anybody plans to harm me. Allah is enough for me during the pangs of death. Allah is enough for me at the time of questioning in the grave. Allah is enough for me when my actions will be weighed on the scales on the Day of Qiyaamah. Allah is enough for me at the time when I have to pass over the Bridge. Allah is enough for me. There is no supreme being besides Him, on Him have I placed my trust and He is the Rabb of the Great Throne
35. O Allah, make death beloved to all those who believe that our Nabi Muhammad is Your Messenger

36. O Allah, You are the Mighty Rabb. Nothing created by You can encompass You. You see everything, yet You cannot be seen. You are at a very lofty position. To You belongs the Hereafter and this World
Life and death are dedicated to You. You are the ultimate end and goal. All things will return to You
We seek refuge in You against disgrace and humiliation

37. O Allah, I ask of You to bless me with the reward of the Shaakireen (Those who are grateful to You), the respect granted to those who are very close to You, the company of the Ambiyaa , the yaqeen (conviction) of the truthful, the humility of the pious and the submission of those who have Yaqeen (complete conviction)
O The Most Merciful and Compassionate, bless me with all of this till my death

38. O Allah, I beg of You through the past favours which You have blessed me with and through the good tests which You have put me through and by the bounties which You rain upon me that You admit me into Jannah by Your grace and kindness
39. O Allah, I beg of You by Your Kind Personality and Your Supreme Command that You save me from the Fire, from disbelief and from poverty

40. O Allah, I seek Your protection from sudden death, from being bitten by a snake, or being attacked by a beast, from being drowned or burnt to death, or that I should fall down upon anything and from being killed whilst I’m running away from the battle field
41. O Allah, I beg of You for Imaan that is unshakable, correct guidance and beneficial knowledge
42. O Allah, do not place upon me the favour of an immoral person whom I may have to pay him back in this world or the hereafter

43. O Allah, forgive my sins, expand for me my character (make me big hearted), provide me with halaal sustenance, grant me contentment in my earnings and don’t incline my heart towards something which You have not ordained for me

44. Allah is The Greatest, Allah is The Greatest, Allah is The Greatet. I invoke the blessings of Allah’s name upon my soul, my Deen, my family, my wealth and whatever my Rabb has gifted to me. I begin with the name of Allah which is the best of names, who is the Rabb of the heavens and the earth
I begin with the name of Allah by virtue of which no disease can harm me
I begin with the name of Allah and my reliance is totally upon Him

Allah, verily Allah is my Sustainer and I do not join any partners with Him. O Allah, I beg of You through Your goodness, which You alone bestow, respected is Your protection and lofty is Your praise, there is no deity besides You; to keep me in Your protection against all evils and the accursed shaytaan. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from everything that You have created and I seek Your protection from their evil
I place in front of me the following Surah of the Holy Qur-aan: In the name of Allah, Most Merciful,

Most Gracious. Say: Allah is One. Allah is absolutely independent. He did not give birth to anyone neither did anyone give birth to Him and nor is anyone equal to Him. In front of me, behind me, on my right and left, above me and beneath me

45. Our Rabb, You created and perfected all creation. Our Rabb, You had destined (predetermined everything) and accordingly Your decree was fulfiled. You established Yourself on Your throne (in a manner that is befitting Your majesty). You give death and thereafter You give life again. You provide food and satisfy the appetite. You provide water and quench the thirst. You transport us with Your boats and animals across the land and sea. Enter me into the secrets of Your heavenly court, draw me in closeness to You and grant me an excellent abode
(O Allah) make me from those who fear standing before You, fear Your warnings and are desirous of meeting You. Make me from those who offer sincere repentance to You
And I beg of You to bless me with actions that are accepted by You, sound knowledge, an effort which earns Your appreciation and a trade which never suffers a loss

46. O Allah, I make You a witness to what You have already bore testimony to, regarding Yourself. Your angels, Your Messengers, the learned Ulama have also testified to it, and if anyone has not testified to what You have testified to, then write down my testimony in his place. You are As Salaam (Full of peace), peace comes from You and You are full of blessings, O Most Magnificent and
Most Kind. O Allah, I beg of You to free my neck from the fire of Hell
47. O Allah, please help me during the pangs and pains of death
) 48. The last dua that Rasulullah made was as follows: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and join me with the Highest Companion. (i.e. join me with You O Allah!)
49. Glorified is Your Rabb, The Rabb of Honour and Power. He is free from what the unbelievers say about Him
Peace be upon the Messengers and all praise is due to Allah, the Cherisher of the worlds
